hotkey.description: Global Hotkey to open the Fancy Tiles layout editor

snapLeftHotkey.description: Move the focused window to the region on the left

snapRightHotkey.description: Move the focused window to the region on the right

snapUpHotkey.description: Move the focused window to the region above

snapDownHotkey.description: Move the focused window to the region below

snapZone1Hotkey.description: Move the focused window to region 1

snapZone2Hotkey.description: Move the focused window to region 2

snapZone3Hotkey.description: Move the focused window to region 3

snapZone4Hotkey.description: Move the focused window to region 4

snapZone5Hotkey.description: Move the focused window to region 5

snapZone6Hotkey.description: Move the focused window to region 6

snapZone7Hotkey.description: Move the focused window to region 7

snapZone8Hotkey.description: Move the focused window to region 8

snapZone9Hotkey.description: Move the focused window to region 9

enableSnappingModifiers.tooltip: When set, pressing the key modifier while dragging (de)activates the snapping

activateWithNonPrimaryButton.description: Toggle snapping with secondary mouse button
activateWithNonPrimaryButton.tooltip: When enabled, pressing the secondary mouse button while dragging (de)activates the snapping

autoStartSnapping.tooltip: When enabled, snapping activates immediately when a window drag begins. You can still toggle it off with the modifier key or secondary mouse button.

overlayColor.tooltip: The region under the mouse is drawn with a translucent fill and a solid border in this color

enableMultiSnappingModifiers.description: Key modifier to enable merging additional regions
enableMultiSnappingModifiers.tooltip: When this key modifier is held down in snapping mode, all selected regions will be merged into a single region into which the window will snap

mergeAdjacentOnHover.description: Merge regions within the mouse radius
mergeAdjacentOnHover.tooltip: When enabled, all regions with a radius of the mouse cursor are merged into a single region into which the window will snap

showGuideLines.description: Show guide lines in the grid editor
showGuideLines.tooltip: When enabled, guide lines at 1/3, 1/2 and 2/3 are shown in the grid editor when splitting a region

mergingRadius.description: Radius around the mouse cursor used for merging
